create_trainer_instance: create a Trainer instance with data, model, logging, checkpoint configs and max epochs for DDP training
run_training_loop: run the full training loop across epochs with optional validation at configured frequency
run_validation_epoch: run a validation epoch over the val dataset and log losses, meters, and timing stats
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state, epoch, loss, and best meter values to disk
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint to resume training from a saved epoch with optimizer and scaler state
